flavor.text: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.
Spirits that wander this world are placed into Pumpkaboo’s body. They’re then moved on to the afterlife.
It is said to carry wandering spirits to the place where they belong so they can move on.
The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.

abilities.name: Pickup
abilities.description: The Pokémon may pick up an item another Pokémon used during a battle. It may pick up items outside of battle, too.

abilities.name: Frisk
abilities.description: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon can check an opposing Pokémon's held item.

abilities.name: Insomnia
abilities.description: The Pokémon's insomnia prevents it from falling asleep.
